body: The Alpine Voyager is the epitome of luxury and functionality, crafted for adventurers seeking off-grid freedom without compromising on comfort. Built on the rugged Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD platform with the top-tier El Capitan build package, this camper van is tailored for those who value style and performance. Outfitted with an all-terrain lift, matte black Arsenal wheels, and a premium roof rack with a side ladder, it’s ready to tackle any landscape. The electric awning with integrated LED lighting adds a touch of convenience and ambiance to your outdoor escapes.

Step inside to discover a meticulously designed interior featuring a wood-stained ceiling, recessed LED lighting, and warm, espresso-stained accents. The vinyl wood-style flooring in Cafecito complements the white cabinetry, painted in Dunn Edwards Castlerock for a sleek yet cozy feel. This camper van offers a full kitchen with an acacia butcher block countertop, stainless steel sink, and Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator/freezer. A portable single-burner induction cooktop and a built-in spice shelf above the kitchen window make cooking on the road a breeze.

For comfort and practicality, the Alpine Voyager includes a tiled indoor shower, a dry flush Laveo toilet, and a diesel-powered Espar cabin heater. The premium insulation package ensures year-round comfort, while the 12V Nomadic air conditioner and Maxxair Deluxe fan keep the cabin cool on hot summer days. The van also features a queen-sized memory foam bed and a custom-built L-bench with a pull-out sofa option, offering ample sleeping and lounging options.

The off-grid electrical system is robust, featuring a 400W solar array, an 800Ah lithium iron battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter/charger. A Weboost cell signal booster ensures connectivity wherever your adventures take you, while the full bug net set keeps nature where it belongs—outside. Additional features like the integrated safe, fire extinguisher, and carbon monoxide/smoke detector ensure peace of mind on every journey.

From its rugged exterior to its thoughtfully designed interior, the Alpine Voyager redefines van life. Whether scaling mountain trails or relaxing by the beach, this custom camper van offers the perfect balance of adventure and luxury, making it the ultimate travel companion.
